material_result: In a simplified source-derived motion control with a deliberately spurious train-time direction-position correlation, a raw GRU collapsed from 92.92% IID to 9.67% after position shift, while the same GRU after translation normalization retained 92.78%; a centered non-recurrent linear trajectory model reached 99.73%. Under shift plus 60% frame-drop/hold, centered GRU was 82.71% and centered linear 90.03%, raw GRU 9.33%. This narrows the current PRG mechanism hypothesis toward low-dimensional primitive isolation/disentanglement as a sufficient contributor in the simple regime; it is not an exact PRG or real-video replication.
